statement: S2-01c local gateway fault and delay fixtures for a registered KOBO-001 Draft. Four separate parts: what the public reporting path is expected to publish, which reports are intentionally delayed or missing, which local gateway fault controls a fixture may drive, and the private Lab oracle. Only public report text ever reaches the gateway; nothing in delayed_cases' oracle fields, fault_controls or private_oracle enters V3, Batch V2 or GatewayDiagnosticsV1. A local IPC reconnect is not an HTTPS retry and nothing here is central receipt.

public_expected.rule: Every published_at is at or after its source_time; a delayed report keeps its source_time and value.

missing_cases.rule: Dropped samples of the profile's dropout draw publish no report and no envelope; they stay missing, never filled.

fault_controls.how: stop the gateway process, step the world, restart it, advance the publication clock to the same instant
fault_controls.expect: publication refused while down; delayed report stays PENDING; earlier envelope and batch bytes unchanged after reconnect; one release, no new sequence on repeat
acquisition continues; local read shows WARN with INJECTED_FAULT_FIXTURE provenance

fault_controls.how: inject_fault DISK_PRESSURE STOP, step the world
fault_controls.expect: DISK_PRESSURE_STOP refusal before any sequence; existing bytes retained; clearing it lets the replay admit what was refused
local read shows 1500 ms with INJECTED_FAULT_FIXTURE provenance; unknown otherwise
